## What would you like to explain / O que você quer explicar

Describe the real use case. English or Portuguese is welcome.

## Suggested result / Resultado desejado

A small diagram spec, sketch, or example document helps.

## Current limitation / Limitação atual

What prevents the existing diagram types or workflow from handling this?
